tools.name: search_carriers
tools.description: Find road freight carriers in Europe that run a route and offer the equipment, services or certificates a load needs. Write the query plainly: the places of loading and delivery (town, postcode or country), then what is needed, e.g. "reefer from Venlo to Rome", "ADR tank Rotterdam to Poland", "group

tools.name: get_carrier
tools.description: One carrier's full profile on Fitralo, with its phone, e-mail and website and where and how it carries. Use it after search_carriers, which gives no contact details: for a carrier the user picked, wants to contact or wants to know more about. To find or compare carriers, use search_carriers. One car

findings.title: Tool description changed since last scan
findings.detail: Tool "search_carriers" changed its description with no version change. Silent description changes are how a trusted server turns malicious after review.
